<a name="Condition"></a>

Condition is one observed aspect of a resource, for UI and automation consumers. Mirrors the Kubernetes metav1.Condition shape.

```go
type Condition struct {

    // Condition type. e.g. Ready, Available, Progressing, Degraded
    Type string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=type,proto3" json:"type,omitempty"`
    // Condition status: True, False, or Unknown.
    Status string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=status,proto3" json:"status,omitempty"`
    // Machine-readable reason for the last transition.
    Reason string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=reason,proto3" json:"reason,omitempty"`
    // Human-readable detail about the last transition.
    Message string `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=message,proto3" json:"message,omitempty"`
    // When the condition last changed status.
    LastTransitionTime *timestamppb.Timestamp `protobuf:"bytes,5,opt,name=last_transition_time,json=lastTransitionTime,proto3" json:"last_transition_time,omitempty"`
    // Generation of the spec this condition was computed from.
    ObservedGeneration int64 `protobuf:"varint,6,opt,name=observed_generation,json=observedGeneration,proto3" json:"observed_generation,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="ImageBuildServiceClient"></a>
## type ImageBuildServiceClient

ImageBuildServiceClient is the client API for ImageBuildService service.

For semantics around ctx use and closing/ending streaming RPCs, please refer to https://pkg.go.dev/google.golang.org/grpc/?tab=doc#ClientConn.NewStream.

ImageBuilds are executions — there is no Update or Patch. To build again, create a new ImageBuild.

```go
type ImageBuildServiceClient interface {
    // Trigger a build against an existing SupplyChain.
    CreateImageBuild(ctx context.Context, in *CreateImageBuildRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CreateImageBuildResponse, error)
    // Fetch an ImageBuild CR by name.
    GetImageBuild(ctx context.Context, in *GetImageBuildRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*GetImageBuildResponse, error)
    // List ImageBuild CRs with optional phase/supply-chain filter and paging.
    ListImageBuilds(ctx context.Context, in *ListImageBuildsRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*ListImageBuildsResponse, error)
    // Delete an ImageBuild CR and its owned PipelineRun, result and signature.
    DeleteImageBuild(ctx context.Context, in *DeleteImageBuildRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*DeleteImageBuildResponse, error)
    // Stream phase transitions for an ImageBuild CR.
    // Closes when the build reaches a terminal phase (SUCCEEDED, FAILED).
    WatchImageBuild(ctx context.Context, in *WatchImageBuildRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (grpc.ServerStreamingClient[WatchImageBuildResponse], error)
}
```

<a name="PipelineStepResults"></a>
## type PipelineStepResults

PipelineStepResults holds the structured output of the pipeline steps. Populated from PipelineRun results after a terminal state is reached.

```go
type PipelineStepResults struct {

    // Full git commit SHA that was cloned.
    Commit string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=commit,proto3" json:"commit,omitempty"`
    // Date of the commit, as reported by git.
    CommitterDate string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=committer_date,json=committerDate,proto3" json:"committer_date,omitempty"`
    // Git repository URL.
    RepoUrl string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=repo_url,json=repoUrl,proto3" json:"repo_url,omitempty"`
    // Fully qualified image reference that was built and pushed.
    ImageUrl string `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=image_url,json=imageUrl,proto3" json:"image_url,omitempty"`
    // Content-addressable digest of the built image.
    ImageDigest string `protobuf:"bytes,5,opt,name=image_digest,json=imageDigest,proto3" json:"image_digest,omitempty"`
    // PASS or FAIL from the Trivy vulnerability scan.
    TrivyScanSummary string `protobuf:"bytes,6,opt,name=trivy_scan_summary,json=trivyScanSummary,proto3" json:"trivy_scan_summary,omitempty"`
    // Number of CRITICAL vulnerabilities found.
    TrivyCriticalCount int32 `protobuf:"varint,7,opt,name=trivy_critical_count,json=trivyCriticalCount,proto3" json:"trivy_critical_count,omitempty"`
    // Number of HIGH vulnerabilities found.
    TrivyHighCount int32 `protobuf:"varint,8,opt,name=trivy_high_count,json=trivyHighCount,proto3" json:"trivy_high_count,omitempty"`
    // Total HIGH + CRITICAL count.
    TrivyTotalCount int32 `protobuf:"varint,9,opt,name=trivy_total_count,json=trivyTotalCount,proto3" json:"trivy_total_count,omitempty"`
    // Path to the SARIF report in the pipeline workspace.
    TrivySarifPath string `protobuf:"bytes,10,opt,name=trivy_sarif_path,json=trivySarifPath,proto3" json:"trivy_sarif_path,omitempty"`
    // SonarQube quality gate result. Empty when the step did not run.
    SonarGateStatus string `protobuf:"bytes,11,opt,name=sonar_gate_status,json=sonarGateStatus,proto3" json:"sonar_gate_status,omitempty"`
    // PASS when the build's last step verified the pushed image the way
    // admission does: keyless signature and authorization attestation by the
    // SupplyChain's ServiceAccount. Empty when that step did not run or did
    // not pass.
    PolicyVerification string `protobuf:"bytes,12,opt,name=policy_verification,json=policyVerification,proto3" json:"policy_verification,omitempty"`
    // Certificate identity the signature and the attestation were verified
    // against.
    VerifiedSigner string `protobuf:"bytes,13,opt,name=verified_signer,json=verifiedSigner,proto3" json:"verified_signer,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="SupplyChainPolicyServiceClient"></a>
## type SupplyChainPolicyServiceClient

SupplyChainPolicyServiceClient is the client API for SupplyChainPolicyService service.

For semantics around ctx use and closing/ending streaming RPCs, please refer to https://pkg.go.dev/google.golang.org/grpc/?tab=doc#ClientConn.NewStream.

```go
type SupplyChainPolicyServiceClient interface {
    // Declare a new SupplyChainPolicy.
    CreateSupplyChainPolicy(ctx context.Context, in *CreateSupplyChainPolicyRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CreateSupplyChainPolicyResponse, error)
    // Fetch a SupplyChainPolicy CR by name.
    GetSupplyChainPolicy(ctx context.Context, in *GetSupplyChainPolicyRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*GetSupplyChainPolicyResponse, error)
    // Full replace of a SupplyChainPolicy spec.
    UpdateSupplyChainPolicy(ctx context.Context, in *UpdateSupplyChainPolicyRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*UpdateSupplyChainPolicyResponse, error)
    // Partial update via JSON merge patch RFC 7396.
    PatchSupplyChainPolicy(ctx context.Context, in *PatchSupplyChainPolicyRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*PatchSupplyChainPolicyResponse, error)
    // List SupplyChainPolicy CRs with optional supply-chain/mode filter and paging.
    ListSupplyChainPolicies(ctx context.Context, in *ListSupplyChainPoliciesRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*ListSupplyChainPoliciesResponse, error)
    // Delete a SupplyChainPolicy CR and its rendered admission policies.
    DeleteSupplyChainPolicy(ctx context.Context, in *DeleteSupplyChainPolicyRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*DeleteSupplyChainPolicyResponse, error)
    // Stream changes to a SupplyChainPolicy CR.
    // Streams indefinitely — policies have no terminal phase; close client-side.
    WatchSupplyChainPolicy(ctx context.Context, in *WatchSupplyChainPolicyRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (grpc.ServerStreamingClient[WatchSupplyChainPolicyResponse], error)
}
```

<a name="SupplyChainServiceClient"></a>
## type SupplyChainServiceClient

SupplyChainServiceClient is the client API for SupplyChainService service.

For semantics around ctx use and closing/ending streaming RPCs, please refer to https://pkg.go.dev/google.golang.org/grpc/?tab=doc#ClientConn.NewStream.

```go
type SupplyChainServiceClient interface {
    // Declare a new SupplyChain.
    CreateSupplyChain(ctx context.Context, in *CreateSupplyChainRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CreateSupplyChainResponse, error)
    // Fetch a SupplyChain CR by name.
    GetSupplyChain(ctx context.Context, in *GetSupplyChainRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*GetSupplyChainResponse, error)
    // Full replace of a SupplyChain spec.
    UpdateSupplyChain(ctx context.Context, in *UpdateSupplyChainRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*UpdateSupplyChainResponse, error)
    // Partial update via JSON merge patch RFC 7396.
    PatchSupplyChain(ctx context.Context, in *PatchSupplyChainRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*PatchSupplyChainResponse, error)
    // List SupplyChain CRs with optional phase/repository filter and paging.
    ListSupplyChains(ctx context.Context, in *ListSupplyChainsRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*ListSupplyChainsResponse, error)
    // Delete a SupplyChain CR and its owned pipeline resources.
    DeleteSupplyChain(ctx context.Context, in *DeleteSupplyChainRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*DeleteSupplyChainResponse, error)
    // Stream phase transitions for a SupplyChain CR.
    // Streams indefinitely — supply chains have no terminal phase; close client-side.
    WatchSupplyChain(ctx context.Context, in *WatchSupplyChainRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (grpc.ServerStreamingClient[WatchSupplyChainResponse], error)
}
```

<a name="SupplyChainSigning"></a>
## type SupplyChainSigning

SupplyChainSigning configures keyless signing \(Cosign \+ Fulcio \+ Rekor\). Every empty endpoint falls back to the public Sigstore instance.

```go
type SupplyChainSigning struct {

    // Fulcio certificate authority endpoint.
    // Empty means https://fulcio.sigstore.dev
    FulcioUrl string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=fulcio_url,json=fulcioUrl,proto3" json:"fulcio_url,omitempty"`
    // Rekor transparency log endpoint.
    // Empty means https://rekor.sigstore.dev
    RekorUrl string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=rekor_url,json=rekorUrl,proto3" json:"rekor_url,omitempty"`
    // Certificate transparency log Fulcio writes to.
    // Empty means https://ctfe.sigstore.dev
    CtLogUrl string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=ct_log_url,json=ctLogUrl,proto3" json:"ct_log_url,omitempty"`
    // OIDC issuer for keyless signing.
    // Empty means https://oauth2.sigstore.dev/auth
    OidcIssuer string `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=oidc_issuer,json=oidcIssuer,proto3" json:"oidc_issuer,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="SupplyChainSteps"></a>
## type SupplyChainSteps

SupplyChainSteps enables or disables individual pipeline steps. Boolean steps are optional so that unset is distinguishable from false — an unset step is enabled.

```go
type SupplyChainSteps struct {

    // Build the image with Cloud Native Buildpacks.
    Buildpacks *bool `protobuf:"varint,1,opt,name=buildpacks,proto3,oneof" json:"buildpacks,omitempty"`
    // Static analysis via SonarQube. Absent means the step is skipped.
    SonarQube *SupplyChainSonarQube `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=sonar_qube,json=sonarQube,proto3" json:"sonar_qube,omitempty"`
    // Scan the image for vulnerabilities with Trivy.
    Trivy *bool `protobuf:"varint,3,opt,name=trivy,proto3,oneof" json:"trivy,omitempty"`
    // Sign the image with Cosign + Sigstore.
    Sign *bool `protobuf:"varint,4,opt,name=sign,proto3,oneof" json:"sign,omitempty"`
    // Attest build provenance via Tekton Chains.
    Attest *bool `protobuf:"varint,5,opt,name=attest,proto3,oneof" json:"attest,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```
